pattern: settles a proposal for the member
experience: A member asks their agent to just pick an option on an open proposal; only a member settles a proposal (需要你定), so the agent neither supersedes it nor records the choice as its own decision.
rule: decision_record: Only a member settles a proposal, so never pass a proposal as `supersedes`, nor a decision an open proposal would replace; give your recommendation in your reply or a ticket note.
